# ARC Grid Reasoning

Use this skill for ARC and Continual-ARC tasks where a colored input grid must be transformed. Infer the simplest rule consistent with demonstrations and apply it exactly to the test input.

## Continual-ARC scoring discipline

A demo request and a wrong submission each incur a cost. Use demonstrations to disambiguate rather than to postpone reasoning.
